```{r setup-mascot_anchors, include = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
studio_character <- if (exists("studio_character")) studio_character else formals(mascot::mascot)$character
```

### `r mascot::mascot_character(studio_character)$name`'s anchors

```{r mascot_anchors-table, echo = FALSE}
anchors <- mascot::mascot_anchors(studio_character)
if (nrow(anchors)) {
  guide_table(anchors)
} else {
  htmltools::tags$p(paste(mascot::mascot_character(studio_character)$name, "has no anchors"))
}
```
